# Erimo — Full-Stack Developer

> Portfolio site for Erimo, a full-stack developer specializing in React, Node.js, and modern web applications. Based in Lagos, Nigeria.

## Core facts

- **Name:** Erimo
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer
- **Stack:** React, Node.js (Express), MongoDB, JWT, Redux Toolkit, TailwindCSS, Vite
- **Services:** Web Development, Responsive Design, Performance Optimization
- **Contact email:** eromoxlx@gmail.com
- **Location:** Lagos, Nigeria

## Key pages

- Home: https://erimo-portfolio.netlify.app/ — hero, services, skills, featured projects, resume, blog preview, testimonials
- Projects: https://erimo-portfolio.netlify.app/projects — project showcase with status badges (completed / in progress)
- Blog: https://erimo-portfolio.netlify.app/blog — articles and tutorials (video support for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, etc.)
- Skills: https://erimo-portfolio.netlify.app/skills — skills organized by category (Frontend, Backend, Mobile, DevOps, Tooling)
- Resume: https://erimo-portfolio.netlify.app/resume — downloadable resume
- Contact: https://erimo-portfolio.netlify.app/contact — contact form, email, phone, location

## About

This is a personal portfolio and content management system: blog with rich media (incl. embedded videos), project showcase, skills index, testimonials slider, dark mode, and a secure admin dashboard for managing all content.
